name: Generalized Joseph Projector with Linear Interpolation
aliases: Generalized Joseph Projector with Linear Interpolation (GJPlin)
axis-aligned grid traversal with bilinear/spline interpolation
definition: A branchless 3D Joseph projector employing linear interpolation. It uses driving axis aligned sampling to ensure an optimal amount of sampling points (voxels neither skipped nor oversampled) and interpolated sampling among remaining dimensions.
summary: The Generalized Joseph Projector with Linear Interpolation is a branchless, ray-driven algorithm that uses driving-axis-aligned sampling and bilinear interpolation to accurately sample 3D volumes while avoiding nearest-neighbor artifacts.
